Turn AI ideas into solutions that run in production
We are looking for an AI Architect who wants to help clients achieve real results in marketing and communications, leveraging AI to get there. You will take technical ownership of some of our larger AI engagements and make sure the solution delivers the outcome the client is paying for. This is not about pilots. It is about solutions that keep running after the project closes.
The role
You will work alongside Comprend's AI team and our strategists, and in close collaboration with Aura's AI team. In practice, that means:

You lead client engagements. You agree the business outcome with the client, scope and design the solution, and follow up that the outcome is reached once it is live.

You redesign the process. You map how the work gets done today, find where AI creates the most value, and design the new way of working, including where people stay in control.

You build. You write code, set up integrations, and make architecture decisions across agents, RAG pipelines, workflow automation, governance, and AI-augmented content and campaign workflows. You know when to do the work yourself and when to hand it on.

You are the AI authority in the room. You run a workshop with a CMO as well as a CTO, or an executive meeting on your own. You join sales conversations to scope work realistically and say what is feasible.

You bridge ambition and constraints. You turn what marketing and communications leaders want into systems that ship, explain trade-offs in terms they understand, and take part in IT security reviews.

You raise the bar. You set technical standards, review the team's work, coach colleagues, and turn what works well into something we can reuse.

What good looks like after 12 months

You have taken at least two client AI engagements from first workshop to production, with solutions that deliver the outcome agreed with the client

Clients trust you enough to involve you early in their next AI decisions

You have helped raise the technical quality of the team, with shared standards that others follow

Who you are
You have spent years in marketing and communications and built the technical depth to put AI to work in it.
You have a consultancy mindset. You work directly with clients and colleagues, solve the problem they actually have and turn needs into action. You speak marketing as fluently as you speak tech, and can explain a RAG pipeline to a head of brand and a brand brief to an engineer.
You start from the business outcome and the process behind it and work back to the solution. You are ready to challenge how things are done today, and you think in constraints, not just possibilities. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can move without complete information. You care about craft: the agents, prompts and architectures you ship hold a high standard and keep running after the project closes.
To succeed in this role you bring a combination of the following experience and strengths:

Substantial experience from a marketing, communications or agency environment, with a clear understanding of how marketing and communications teams work

Hands-on technical depth, shown by having built and shipped AI and LLM solutions in production

Client-facing experience at senior level, including scoping and advising on engagements

Fluent English. Swedish is an advantage but not required

A bonus: experience working with clients that operate across several markets

Working at Comprend
Comprend is a place of belonging, where people are valued and empowered to create impact. We embrace diverse perspectives, bridge gaps, dare to challenge and win as a team. This is a full-time position based in Sweden. Our team works mainly from our offices in Stockholm and Helsingborg, and we enjoy being together there, so we are looking for someone who lives in Sweden and can work from one of these offices regularly. We are not able to support relocation for this role. We offer a competitive employment package.
About Comprend
Comprend is a partner for tech-enabled marketing and communication driving transformative impact. We are 200 specialists collaborating across Sweden, Finland and the UK. With extensive expertise and a strong track record in B2B, B2C and corporate communication, we help clients decode complexity, influence audiences and strengthen brand perception. With us, your voice will be one of many diverse and highly valued perspectives that shape how we work and partner with our clients. Comprend is part of Aura, a leading consultancy group with over 500 specialists across a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

jobs.description:
Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua)
We are seeking a highly-motivated researcher in fisheries stock assessment at the Department of Aquatic Resources for a part-time position (75%), starting in February 2027. The researcher will contribute to development of the stock assessment for Atlantic salmon in the Baltic Sea, and potentially other salmonid species, as well as participating in international research projects. This position will have a focus on developing and implementing Bayesian statistical models, so prior experience in this field is required.
About the position
The ICES Baltic salmon and trout assessment working group (WGBAST) conducts an annual stock assessment that serves as the basis for catch advice for salmon stocks in the Baltic Sea using an MSY (maximum sustainable yield) approach. The stock assessment consists of a state-space Bayesian modelling framework that integrates multiple data sources at different life stages. This assessment framework is currently undergoing a process of development and review, and we are seeking a researcher who can contribute to this work. At the same time, the new researcher will contribute to ongoing research projects that are linked to the stock assessment.
Tasks
Contribute to the stock assessment and basis for scientific advice for Atlantic salmon in the Baltic Sea (developing and implementing Bayesian statistical models).
Improving the biological realism of stock assessment models (analysing life-history trait data and incorporating spatio-temporal variation in life-history traits to stock assessment models).
Participation in international expert groups.
Participate in and contribute to ongoing research projects within the Institute for Freshwater Research. Examples include BAYeFISH, a project aimed at improving inference of juvenile fish density using hierarchical Bayesian models, and diadPATH, a new EU Horizon project that will support more holistic assessment methods for diadromous fish species (accounting for effects of hydropower and climate change, increased biological realism and improved fisheries reference points for status evaluation).
The successful candidate is also expected to publish scientific articles and apply for their own research funding.

The researcher will be based at SLU’s Institute of Freshwater Research near Stockholm. The Institute of Freshwater Research offers a stimulating work environment, with a dedicated research group on diadromous fish species (including eel and salmon stock assessment). In addition, the researcher will have access to a wider international research network through the EU diadPATH project.
Your profile
Required
 
PhD in quantitative ecology or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience of Bayesian statistics
Experience programming with Nimble, JAGS or similar BUGS language
Proven track record of publishing in international scientific journals
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
Fluency in written and spoken English

 
Desirable
 
Knowledge of fisheries stock assessment methods
Experience with hierarchical Bayesian models
Proven track record of securing external research funding
Previous experience working with diadromous fish species
Experience analysing large data sets
Fluency in written and spoken Swedish

 
Assessment criteria
 
Assessment will be based on the applicant’s scientific competence and experience relevant to the research area of the position. Emphasis will be placed on documented experience in Bayesian statistics and ecological modelling. The assessment will also take into account personal qualities, such as your ability to collaborate, work independently and communicate clearly.
About us
At the Department of Aquatic Resources, we are engaged in marine monitoring, management advice, research and education in aquatic ecology with a focus on fish and shellfish. The department is the largest department at SLU with about 230 employees at four main offices (Uppsala, Lysekil, Öregrund and Stockholm) and four research stations.
 
Welcome to visit us at http://www.slu.se/aquaticresources!
 
Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

The University of Gothenburg tackles society’s challenges with diverse knowledge. 58 000 students and 6800 employees make the university a large and inspiring place to work and study. Strong research and attractive study programmes attract researchers and students from around the world. With new knowledge and new perspectives, the University contributes to a better future.
The Department of Health and Care Sciences conducts education and research focusing on healthcare, health and people's living conditions. We educate nurses, radiographers, specialist nurses and midwives, with the aim of meeting society's need for skilled and committed healthcare professionals.
Research at the Department covers a wide range of areas, with a shared foundation in person-centred and evidence-based care. We are nationally and internationally recognised as a leader in person-centred care, an approach that underpins our education, research and collaboration with healthcare providers.
The Department is part of Sahlgrenska Academy at the University of Gothenburg and is located at Campus Medicinareberget, close to Sahlgrenska University Hospital. This provides an environment characterised by interprofessional collaboration, strong links to clinical practice and high academic standards. The Department has approximately 1,200 students enrolled in first- and second-cycle programmes leading to professional qualifications in healthcare.
We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and with different experiences and perspectives. We value diversity and actively promote an inclusive and equal working environment where all employees have opportunities to thrive and develop. To support a healthy work-life balance, we offer flexible working arrangements.
The University of Gothenburg is a Swedish government agency, which means that employees benefit from favourable employment conditions, generous annual leave and an occupational pension scheme.
Read more about working at the University of Gothenburg on our website: Work at the University of Gothenburg

We are looking for a colleague with a strong interest in teaching and a commitment to course development and the advancement of teaching and learning. The successful applicant should be highly motivated to share knowledge with students and demonstrate a strong commitment to educational development.
The position will primarily be based in the Section for Care in Long-term Conditions. Teaching will take place at both first- and second-cycle levels. Depending on operational needs, duties may also involve collaboration with other sections within the Department.
Subject area 
Nursing with a specialisation in Healthcare for Children and Adolescents 
Subject area description 
Nursing is grounded in a humanistic view of the person and encompasses knowledge of human development, health and well-being in relation to birth, ill health, suffering and death. It aims to promote a meaningful life despite illness or disability and to enable a dignified death.
The focus of nursing is to alleviate suffering, promote health and prevent disease and ill health at individual, group and societal levels, where the applicant's clinical work experience should be applied in relevant teaching situations. Nursing addresses needs and challenges related to health, ill health and everyday life, while also recognising individuals’ resources and their ability to manage their life circumstances.
Duties 
The duties include teaching and assessment, course coordination, supervision of degree projects and supervision of students during clinical placements. The duties will primarily be carried out within the subject area of healthcare for children and adolescents at both first- and second-cycle levels. Teaching and other duties within the Department’s other courses and programmes are also included, particularly at first-cycle level in the Nursing Programme.
As course coordinator, responsibilities include planning courses, developing and coordinating learning outcomes, learning activities, assessment methods and assessment criteria in relation to course content, objectives and current research in higher education pedagogy. The role also involves ensuring the quality of education through validated evaluation methods.
Administrative duties related to educational activities constitute a significant part of the role.
The duties also include actively contributing to the development of the main field of study and collaborating with healthcare providers on clinical placements. Other duties may also be assigned, and the responsibilities associated with the position may change over time.
The position also involves actively contributing to the achievement of the Department’s objectives and operational plan. This includes supporting the development of the academic environment within the section’s Complete Academic Environment (KAM). In addition, all staff members are expected to participate in scheduled departmental meetings and joint activities.
The successful candidate will teach in both Swedish and English.

About WAHEGURU AB
WAHEGURU AB is an established Swedish restaurant company specialising in restaurant and food service operations.
As part of our plans to develop and expand our restaurant operations, we are seeking an experienced and professionally skilled Indian Cuisine Chef who can contribute specialist culinary knowledge, maintain high food quality standards, and support the continued development of our kitchen.
We are particularly interested in candidates with extensive practical experience in authentic North Indian and Punjabi cuisine, traditional tandoor cooking, Indian curry preparation, and professional restaurant kitchen operations.
Main Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
Independently preparing and cooking authentic Indian dishes according to traditional recipes and restaurant quality standards.

Managing daily kitchen preparation, including curry bases, marinades, sauces, spice blends, and food preparation.

Preparing traditional North Indian and Punjabi dishes, including Butter Chicken, Chicken Tikka Masala, Lamb Karahi, Rogan Josh, Korma, Jalfrezi, and other regional specialities.

Operating and managing traditional tandoor ovens for preparing Tandoori Chicken, Chicken Tikka, Seekh Kebab, Lamb Tikka, and freshly baked Indian breads.

Preparing different varieties of naan, roti, paratha, and other traditional Indian breads.

Preparing authentic biryani, rice dishes, lentil preparations, vegetarian curries, and Indian side dishes.

Ensuring consistency in flavour, texture, presentation, cooking methods, and portion sizes.

Developing and improving menu items while maintaining authentic Indian culinary traditions.

Managing ingredient preparation, stock rotation, food storage, and minimising kitchen waste.

Maintaining kitchen hygiene, food safety, temperature controls, and allergen procedures in accordance with Swedish food safety regulations.

Coordinating kitchen operations during busy lunch and dinner services.

Supporting and training other kitchen employees in Indian cooking techniques when required.

Assisting restaurant management with menu planning, food costing, and kitchen efficiency.

Required Professional Expertise
1. Indian Curry and Gravy Preparation
Candidates must have advanced practical knowledge of traditional Indian curry preparation, including the preparation of onion-tomato gravy bases, makhani sauces, cream-based curries, slow-cooked meat dishes, and vegetarian specialities.
2. Traditional Tandoor Cooking
Professional experience operating a traditional clay tandoor oven is required, including meat marination, temperature control, tandoori grilling, kebab preparation, and baking Indian breads.
3. Indian Spices and Traditional Cooking Techniques
Candidates must demonstrate strong knowledge of Indian spices, including cumin, coriander, turmeric, cardamom, cloves, fenugreek, garam masala, and traditional spice-roasting and tempering techniques.
The chef must be capable of preparing spice blends and marinades from scratch rather than relying exclusively on ready-made commercial sauces.
4. North Indian and Punjabi Cuisine
Practical experience preparing Punjabi and North Indian restaurant dishes is particularly important. Candidates should understand traditional preparation methods and be able to maintain authentic flavours across different menu items.
5. Professional Kitchen Management
Candidates must be able to organise kitchen preparation independently, maintain food quality during high-volume service, manage ingredients efficiently, and follow professional food hygiene procedures.
Qualifications and Experience
Minimum five years of documented professional experience working as an Indian cuisine chef or specialist cook in a commercial restaurant kitchen.

Demonstrated experience in North Indian and Punjabi cuisine.

Strong practical knowledge of tandoor cooking, curry preparation, Indian breads, and biryani.

Ability to independently prepare authentic Indian dishes from raw ingredients.

Experience working in a professional restaurant environment with established food safety and quality procedures.

Ability to manage multiple food orders efficiently during busy service periods.

Good understanding of kitchen hygiene, food handling, and allergen management.

Relevant culinary education, vocational training, or equivalent professional experience.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Basic English communication skills are desirable; Swedish language skills are advantageous.

Personal Qualities
We are looking for a responsible, organised, reliable, and quality-focused chef who takes pride in traditional Indian cooking.
The ideal candidate should be adaptable, capable of working under pressure, and motivated to contribute to the restaurant's long-term development.
What We Offer
Permanent, full-time employment.

Salary and employment conditions in accordance with applicable Swedish requirements and relevant industry standards.

A professional and supportive working environment.

Opportunity to contribute to menu development and restaurant growth.

Long-term professional development within an established Swedish restaurant business.

Application Procedure
Interested candidates are invited to submit an updated CV detailing their professional culinary experience, relevant qualifications, and previous employment references.
Applicants should clearly describe their practical experience in Indian curry preparation, tandoor cooking, Punjabi cuisine, and professional kitchen operations.

Do you like fixing things for people and also figuring out how to stop them breaking in the first place? At CDON Group, our Stockholm office brings together developers, product teams, sales, customer service and leadership, and all of them rely on IT that works. 
We’re looking for an IT Specialist who wants to be more than first-line support. You’ll handle day-to-day support in the office, and you’ll work with our Head of IT on the technical setup and the internal IT processes behind it. When something breaks, you’re the one people come to. When the same thing breaks twice, you’re the one who asks why and fixes the cause. We use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT every day, and we expect this role to as well. We want someone who reaches for automation and AI to solve problems faster, not someone who does the same manual task fifty times.
About us CDON Group is a Swedish listed company with a long history in e-commerce. Our mission is to unleash the power of the marketplace to give the best shopping experience in the Nordics. We run two Nordic marketplaces, CDON and Fyndiq. About the role You’ll report to the Head of IT and be the hands-on IT presence in our Stockholm office. Day to day, that means user support, devices and office tech. Over time, you’ll take ownership of parts of our environment and help improve how we work, with plenty of room to drive things yourself.
What you’ll do

Handle IT support for colleagues in the office and remotely, from laptops and accounts to Wi-Fi, VPN, printers and meeting room tech

Take care of onboarding and offboarding, including setting up and returning computers, phones and accounts

Manage user accounts, groups and permissions in Google Workspace, Slack and other central systems

Enroll and maintain Mac and Windows devices in our MDM, and help develop our device policies and configurations

Keep our asset register up to date and handle ordering and lifecycle of hardware and peripherals

Work with our external IT partners on things like network and Wi-Fi when issues come up

Write and maintain documentation and support guides so colleagues can solve common problems themselves

Help improve our support process

Find manual IT work worth automating and build the automation, using scripts, Google Apps Script, AI agents or whatever fits the job

Help colleagues get started with our AI tools, answer their questions, and support the Head of IT in rolling out AI tools safely across the company

Contribute to security work under the direction of the Head of IT

Who you are You’re a technically curious generalist who likes being close to users. You take ownership, you don’t wait to be told what to do next, and you can tell the difference between urgent and important. You’re social and easy to work with, and you explain technical things in a way people understand. This role is based full-time at our Stockholm office, 5 days a week. We’d especially like to see:

A few years of experience in IT support or a similar role, ideally in a modern office with 50+ users

Hands-on experience with Google Workspace administration, such as accounts, groups and permissions

Experience with MDM tools for Mac, iPhone and Windows, for example Kandji, Intune or similar

Basic networking knowledge, such as Wi-Fi, DNS/DHCP and troubleshooting connectivity

Experience working with tickets and support processes, for example via Slack or Jira

Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, for example to write scripts, troubleshoot or draft documentation, and you can show us an example

Experience with scripting or automation, such as Bash, Python, PowerShell or Google Apps Script

Professional proficiency in English and Swedish

What we offer

A chance to be part of a growth journey and help keep the leading Nordic marketplaces running

A collaborative work environment with colleagues who believe in CDON Group’s mission

A role where you learn from and work closely with the Head of IT, with room to grow your responsibilities

A competitive compensation package, including pension and insurance through Max Matthiessen and the MyBenefit portal

 
Application Process:
Please attach your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your interest and suitability for the job. We will be conducting interviews with candidates on an ongoing basis.

We are looking for an experienced Fundraising Manager to join our European organisation and lead our investment and financing activities across Europe.

The successful candidate will combine strong financial and commercial expertise with an established investor network, excellent negotiation skills and the ability to independently manage complex cross-border transactions.
The Role
Reporting directly to the CEO, you will take ownership of the company's European investment and financing activities, with a particular focus on local equity fundraising, investor engagement, industrial project investment and transaction execution.
You will work closely with senior management, headquarters, European investors and external advisers to develop financing opportunities, execute investment transactions and establish a structured investment and financing framework in Europe.
Equity Fundraising & Financing
Lead European equity fundraising activities, from investor identification and engagement to negotiation and transaction closing.

Establish and expand the company's network of European financial institutions, investment funds and industrial investors.
Maintain professional relationships with existing and potential investors, financing partners and external advisers.

Your Background

It Would Be an Advantage If You Have
Experience in industrial investments, advanced manufacturing, new energy, lithium-ion batteries or related sectors.
Experience leading equity fundraising or strategic investment transactions involving European or Nordic investors.
Experience establishing local investment and financing functions or coordinating cross-border teams.
Familiarity with European industrial investment projects and international corporate structures.
Experience working with international headquarters, senior executives and multidisciplinary advisory teams.

What You Can Expect
You will join an international industrial organisation where investment and financing activities are directly connected to manufacturing development, strategic expansion and long-term business growth in Europe.
The role offers significant responsibility and direct exposure to senior management, European capital markets and cross-border investment projects. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of key financing initiatives, develop investor relationships and contribute directly to the company's European development strategy.
We value professionalism, ownership, collaboration and straightforward communication. We believe good decisions come from different perspectives and encourage an open, respectful and inclusive working environment.

We have calendars that people count down to, toiletry bags made for the wishlist and tools that make everyday routines a little bit better. Here, you’re the one who makes them happen. 💭

Ever heard of Make up Store, Rebecca Stella, Waterclouds or Estelle & Thild? They’re part of our ever-growing family of own brands. Now we’re looking for a Product Manager with experience in both product development and purchasing to own one of our most trend-driven categories: tools and accessories. From spotting the next big thing to holding the finished product in your hand, it’s all yours.

What you’ll do

Fast trends, lots of launches and never a dull week. Over the year you’ll juggle lots of projects, big and small, often at the same time. You plan the assortment, negotiate with our suppliers in Asia and around the world and make sure every product lands with the right quality, cost and margin, right on time. Together with our design resources, you turn trends into products that feel spot on.

→ Take products all the way from brief to shelf: calendars, toiletry bags, tools, lovables and more→ Build the assortment and the strategy behind it, with trends as your compass→ Negotiate price and terms with our suppliers in Asia and other international markets, and push back when it matters→ Keep lots of projects moving at once, without losing track of a single detail→ Brief and steer design and packaging with our design resources, so every product shines in store and online→ Team up with product managers across every category, Brand Managers, Stores and Supply

Your category touches every other category in the team, so you’ll never be short of people to work with.

Who are you?

You spot a trend before it hits the feed. You love the pace, you love the details, and you’re not shy at the negotiating table. A beauty background? Not needed. Fashion, accessories or gifts work just as well, as long as trends have been calling the shots.

What you bring:

3+ years in both product development and purchasing of trend-driven consumer products, in fashion, accessories, beauty or similar
Strong product knowledge and a gut feeling for what’s next
Experience planning an assortment and thinking strategically about it
The confidence to negotiate and challenge suppliers on price and terms
The ability to project manage yourself and keep every detail in check, even when the to-do list is long
Great communication skills and energy from working with lots of people
Fluent English, written and spoken. Swedish is a plus, not a must

Bonus points if you’ve worked directly with suppliers in Asia. Everything Lyko-specific, we’ll teach you on the job.

At Lyko Own Brands we have a lot of fun and get to be creative, but it takes focus and a high pace to keep it all on track. So we’re looking for someone who loves owning both the big picture and the small stuff.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway! Who you are and what you can do matters more to us than your CV.

The practical stuff

This is a permanent position with a six-month probationary period, starting as soon as possible or by agreement. You’ll be based at our office on Sveavägen in Stockholm and report to Elisabet Kernell, Head of Product & Sourcing Own Brands.

We believe great, inclusive cultures are built by people actually meeting and working together, so we’ve landed on what we call “Business First”: at least three days a week at the office, the other two up to you, as long as it works with the needs of the business. A pretty good balance, if you ask us.

Using AI? Totally fine!

Feel free to use AI to polish your wording, we do it too sometimes! But it’s you we want to get to know, not your chatbot. So keep the content your own, with your experiences and thoughts. If you move forward, we’ll dive deeper into your answers later in the process. And just to be clear: a person always makes the call on who moves forward 😊

Apply without CV or cover letter

If this sounds exciting and you’re eager to apply, go ahead and do it ASAP! It’s quick and easy. No CV or cover letter needed. Instead, we ask you to answer a few questions that are valuable for us in our selection process. Please apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Questions about the role? Contact Elisabet Kernell, Head of Product & Sourcing Own Brands, at elisabet.kernell@lyko.com. We look forward to receiving your application! 🌟

Lyko is a haircare and beauty specialist with the ambition to transform the industry.

Who We Are
Allgon is a leading manufacturer of wireless machinery control systems, delivering customized solutions to companies across the industrial sector. Our customers engage with us through our subsidiaries Tele Radio, Åkerströms and Sistematica. We are passionate about developing industrial remote control solutions that enhance safety and efficiency worldwide.
You will join our Product Compliance & QESG team, which works with product compliance, quality, environment, sustainability and management systems. We are a small, close-knit team spread across Gothenburg, Björbo and Málaga. You report to the department manager at the head office in Gothenburg.
The role can be based in Gothenburg, Björbo/Borlänge or Málaga, Spain. You will work closely with colleagues across Allgon’s global organization.

About the Role
As a Certification Engineer at Allgon, you make sure our products obtain and keep all required approvals before and after market release. This covers radio, RF exposure, EMC, electrical safety and functional safety. You will also support the work to meet new requirements under the EU Machinery Regulation and cybersecurity legislation.
You will independently manage certification projects, from updates to existing approvals to new approvals in development projects. You will work closely with R&D, product management, quality, manufacturing, external test laboratories, certification bodies and our subsidiaries.
Key Responsibilities:
Interpret and apply EU and international regulations and standards (RED, EMC, Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, FCC, ISED and others)
Support R&D with functional safety: safety requirements, risk assessment, PL/SIL verification and safety documentation (ISO 13849, IEC 62061, IEC 61508)
Drive product cybersecurity compliance (RED Article 3.3 d/e/f, EN 18031, the Cyber Resilience Act and the Machinery Regulation)
Plan and run certification projects
Coordinate testing with external laboratories, and work with TCB/FCB, Notified Bodies and authorities
Review test reports, technical files, declarations of conformity and product labeling
Manage updates, renewals and maintenance of existing approvals
Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on our products
Provide certification input during new product development and market expansion
Support customer service and subsidiaries with certification expertise

What We’re Looking For
You are a detail-oriented and analytical engineer with a strong interest in product certification and regulatory requirements. You enjoy working independently, take ownership of your tasks and are comfortable coordinating many stakeholders. With a structured approach and clear communication, you turn complex requirements into practical actions that support product development and market access.
Key qualifications include:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
Experience in product certification, regulatory affairs or a similar role
Strong knowledge of RF and EMC standards and global wireless certification requirements
Knowledge of and practical experience with functional safety (ISO 13849, IEC 62061/IEC 61508), e.g. risk assessment and PL/SIL determination and verification
Experience working with EU and international regulations (e.g. RED, EMC, Machinery Regulation, FCC, ISED, MIC)
Ability to review and interpret test reports and certification documentation
Understanding of PLM systems and certification documentation processes
Fluent English, spoken and written. Swedish, Spanish or other languages are also a plus.

It is a plus if you have:
A functional safety certification
Experience with product cybersecurity (RED Article 3.3 d/e/f, EN 18031, CRA)
Experience with RF exposure assessment and TCB/FCB processes
Experience with marine/offshore type approvals from classification societies (e.g. DNV, Lloyd’s Register)
Project management experience

What We Offer
Work with cutting-edge, high-quality products in a dynamic environment
A key role at a time when functional safety, the Machinery Regulation and cybersecurity are reshaping our industry
Opportunities for continuous professional growth and career development.
A challenging and rewarding role within a growing organization
Collective agreement (working in Sweden), including 9 extra days off per calendar year through reduced working hours
3,000 SEK annually for wellness benefits (working in Sweden)

About Allgon
Allgon is a Swedish company specializing in industrial radio control, with a strong track record in wireless technology innovation. Through our brands Tele Radio, Åkerströms and Sistematica, we have built a global presence, employing over 470 professionals and presence in 26 countries.
We offer an exciting work environment in a profitable and growing organization with a strong technical focus. Despite our global reach, we maintain the close-knit atmosphere of a smaller company, where every employee has a voice and can influence the projects they work on.
At Allgon, sustainability is a key priority—ecologically, socially, and financially. We are committed to attracting passionate individuals who share our vision of a safer, more efficient world through advanced wireless technology.
